audience: newsletter publishers who grow and manage subscribers on beehiiv

useCases.title: Report subscribers by tier
useCases.text: List subscribers with their status, tier and tags, filtered by status or tier. List the premium tiers to name each one.

useCases.title: Review recent posts
useCases.text: List posts by status: draft, confirmed or archived. Open one post to read its title, publish date and audience settings.

useCases.title: Tag a subscriber by email address
useCases.text: Find a subscriber by email address. Add tags to group them with others. Tags do not send anything.

useCases.title: Add a subscriber who asked to join
useCases.text: Add an email address as a subscriber of the publication. Use it only for a person who asked to join.

useCases.title: Draft a newsletter issue for review
useCases.text: Create a draft post from HTML. The post is saved as a draft, so you review it in beehiiv before you publish it.
